oe_dyn2_edu_porphyro_rhetoric = {
	potential = {
		owner = {
			OR = {
				has_or_had_tag = BYZ
				has_or_had_tag = ROM

				has_or_had_tag = EPI
				has_or_had_tag = MOE
				culture = { has_culture_group = culture_group:greek_group }
				court_language = language:greek_language
			}
		}
	}
	allow = {
		owner = { prestige >= 15 }
		OR = {
			is_heir = yes
			AND = {
				has_dynasty = yes
				owner = {
					exists = ruler_or_regent
					ruler_or_regent = { has_dynasty = yes }
				}
				dynasty = owner.ruler_or_regent.dynasty
			}
		}
	}
	price_to_select = select_expensive_child_education
	price_to_deselect = deselect_expensive_child_education
	modifier = {
		character_child_education_modifier = 0.70
		character_dip_child_education_modifier = 0.75
		character_mil_child_education_modifier = 0.75
	}
	country_modifier = {
		court_spending_efficiency = -0.04
		cultural_influence_modifier = 0.04
		monthly_army_tradition = 0.02
	}
	on_education_start_effect = {
		set_variable = { name = oe_dyn2_elite_pupil value = 1 }
	}
}
